name: en_api_failures
description: Every kind of model failure (connection, server error, rate limit, authentication): the interview, the review and the test suggestions must go on with the built-in rules.
requirements:
REQ-1: The user can search products by name.
REQ-2: Search results must appear within 2 seconds.
REQ-3: The user enters a search query of up to 100 characters.

issues.note: an empty or too long query
what happens after entering a query

rule.missing_error_handling.REQ-3.value: An empty query is not sent; longer input is cut at 100 characters.

rule.missing_expected_result.REQ-3.value: The result list updates for the entered query.

answers_by_text.value: A 'nothing found' message with a link to all products.
